name: drops
description: Road bike, hands in the drops. Torso 30 deg from horizontal; left crank at the top of the stroke (hip angle about 40 deg, the deepest flexion simiq models), right near the bottom.
provenance: Draft for the Anny spike (fit-engine-poc 2.2), 2026-10-14. Angles from typical road bike-fit ranges (torso 25-35 deg in the drops), to be adjusted visually and against photos of team members on a trainer.
convention: Anny local-ref pose parameterization. Each rotation is [rx, ry, rz] in degrees about axes aligned with the world in the rest pose, applied as Rz*Ry*Rx relative to the parent bone. World axes: +X body's left, -Y forward, +Z up. Positive rx tips a bone forward.
